verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a public REST API with an API reference covering endpoints, authentication, rate limits and errors, plus a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. It also offers a dedicated Status Page API, webhooks, and an official MCP server that can query incidents and manage escalations. Nothing shows UI/API parity, though, and the Terraform provider being built out 'resource by resource' suggests programmatic coverage is still incomplete. missing for 10: an explicit claim or demonstration that every UI action is available via the API, documented API coverage of on-call schedules, workflows, post-mortems, insights and AI features, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.
